title: 2.5 Adaptation and Mitigation Strategies to Climate Change
description: UNFCCC response strategies, adaptation types, Ethiopian practices and mitigation measures. Easy level.

questions.question: Which two response strategies does the UNFCCC highlight?
What does mitigation aim to do?
options: It was likely the warmest century in a millennium
Whether greenhouse gas emissions continue to rise
Reduce greenhouse gas emissions and enhance sinks
A long-term increase in Earth average temperature
questions.correctAnswer: Reduce greenhouse gas emissions and enhance sinks

questions.question: What does adaptation aim to do?
options: Observations of the atmosphere, land and oceans
It is the rigid shell broken into moving plates
Alleviate the adverse impacts of climate change
Continental crust is thinner than oceanic crust
questions.correctAnswer: Alleviate the adverse impacts of climate change

What is reactive adaptation?

Adaptation that takes place after initial impacts have occurred

questions.question: What is anticipatory adaptation?
options: Tropical regions where many developing nations are located
Adaptation that takes place before impacts become apparent
Ocean and atmosphere circulation that redistributes energy
